newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S-E-Banken, Nordbanken in merger talks - paper.
newsitem.headline: S-E-Banken, Nordbanken in merger talks - paper.

text.p: Two of Sweden's leading banking groups, S-E-Banken and Nordbanken, are in merger talks, Swedish financial daily Dagens Industri reported on Tuesday.
The talks could lead to a merger before the end of the year, the paper said.
"According to Dagens Industri's sources, both banks have worked all weekend to reach agreement about conditions for a merger," the paper wrote.
If the deal goes through, S-E-Banken will probably act as the buyer, the paper said.
But other business options could also be in the wind, according to the paper.
"The old rumours that S-E-Banken also is discussing a merger with insurer Trygg-Hansa insist on lingering," the paper wrote.
Nordbanken and S-E-Banken declined comment on the article.
